highlights: Key Takeaways ✓ Priorities on Interim MD CEO: Management highlighted that business operations remain stable, supported by an experienced leadership team, robust operational controls and governance processes.

Key selection criteria include a proven track record, quality and depth of experience, growth leadership, alignment with EQSFB’s existing strategy and the ability to build a robust leadership pipeline.

Subject to timely RBI approval, management expects the selection process to be completed within approximately 4 months. ✓ Business Continuity Ensured: Management reiterated that lending and deposit growth, including CASA and disbursement momentum, remain on track, with any potential deviations largely attributable to macroeconomic factors.
Management has also identified cost-saving initiatives to improve operational efficiency.
valuation: Company Update 13th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 74 Equitas Small Finance Bank Ltd.
Outlook and Valuation The interim MD & CEO’s focus on maintaining business continuity and delivering on the existing business plan should help mitigate near-term execution risks.
We continue to maintain our BUY recommendation on the stock with a target price of Rs 74/share, implying an upside of 28% from the CMP.
watch: BFSI – Banks 1 Interim MD CEO Assures Smooth Transition EQSFB’s stock has remained under pressure, declining ~11% since the announcement of the sudden resignation of its erstwhile MD & CEO, Mr PN Vasudevan, citing investor concerns over a perceived conflict of interest linked to his daughter’s NBFC.
